# Typography · 字体排版

Open font sources with clear licences, commercial foundries worth knowing, type seen in real use, tools, the guides that matter, and a full section for CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) type and typesetting.

86 resources. Columns are explained in README.md; `python3 "$S/catalog.py" find` (`S` = `skills/design-studio/scripts`) searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Open and free font sources · 开源与免费字体

The route away from default typefaces without licence risk. Self-host; do not hot-link.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | Self-hostable open fonts as npm packages with an API | npm i @fontsource-variable/<name> (or @fontsource/<name>) and import it; the API returns weights, subsets, variable flag and licence per family | S | font-foundry | static | free · Each font keeps its own open licence | API `https://api.fontsource.org/v1/fonts/{id}` |
| [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com) | The largest open font library, with variable fonts, language filters and an API | Filter by language (for example Chinese Simplified) and tick Variable before browsing; agents can list every family with category, axes and subsets from the metadata JSON; self-host the files (Fontsource) rather than hot-linking the CSS API | S | font-foundry | js | free · Mostly SIL OFL; some Apache-2.0 | [CSS2 API (URL syntax for families, axes and ranges)](https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/css2); API `https://fonts.google.com/metadata/fonts` |
| [Velvetyne](https://velvetyne.fr) | Libre foundry of expressive, experimental display faces | Use for posters, covers and identities that need a voice; download from each font page, where the licence and designers are listed | A | font-foundry | static | free · SIL OFL |  |

Trial and free-to-try files are for mock-ups only and must not ship.

## Type tools · 字体工具

Scales, fluid type, system stacks, inspection, metrics and subsetting.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Utopia](https://utopia.fyi) | Fluid type and space scales that interpolate between a small and a large viewport, output as CSS clamp() | Set min and max viewport, base size and ratio in the type calculator and copy the clamp() custom properties; the space calculator produces matching fluid spacing | S | tool | static | free | [Fluid type calculator](https://utopia.fyi/type/calculator/); [Fluid space calculator](https://utopia.fyi/space/calculator/) |
| [Modern Font Stacks](https://modernfontstacks.com) | System font stacks by typographic classification, no web fonts needed | Copy a stack by classification (System UI, Humanist, Neo-Grotesque, Monospace Code and others) for zero-download, native-feeling type; the CSS also lives in the GitHub repo | S | guideline | static | free · CC0 | [Stacks as CSS (GitHub, CC0)](https://github.com/system-fonts/modern-font-stacks) |
| [Typescale](https://typescale.com) | Visual type-scale calculator with live preview and export | Compare ratios with the real typeface and your own copy, then export the CSS | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Capsize](https://seek-oss.github.io/capsize/) | Trims text boxes to cap height and baseline using font metrics | Use until CSS text-box (text-box-trim and text-box-edge) reaches Baseline; it is in Chrome, Edge and Safari but not Firefox | A | tool | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Fallback font generator](https://screenspan.net/fallback) | Generates metric overrides so a fallback font matches the web font and avoids layout shift | Paste the result into the @font-face for the fallback | A | tool | static | free |  |

| [WhatTheFont](https://www.myfonts.com/pages/whatthefont) | Identify a typeface from an image | Upload a crop of one clean line of text; results come from the MyFonts catalogue, so cross-check open fonts elsewhere and use 求字体 or 字由 for Chinese | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Transfonter](https://transfonter.org) | Online converter to WOFF2 with subsetting, vertical-metrics fixes and generated @font-face CSS | Use for quick Latin subsetting of fonts you may embed; use cn-font-split for Chinese | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Wakamai Fondue](https://wakamaifondue.com) | Drop a font to see its features, axes, languages and ready CSS | Check what a font can do before designing with it | A | tool | js | free |  |
| [FontDrop!](https://fontdrop.info) | Drop a font file to see its glyphs, metrics, OpenType features, language support and name-table metadata | Check a font's licence and vendor fields and its language coverage before adopting it | A | tool | js | free |  |

## Typography guides · 排版指引

Read the first two in full once.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Practical Typography](https://practicaltypography.com) | Butterick's web book: the most useful typography rules per minute of reading | Read Typography in ten minutes and Summary of key rules | S | book | static | free | [Typography in ten minutes](https://practicaltypography.com/typography-in-ten-minutes.html); [Summary of key rules](https://practicaltypography.com/summary-of-key-rules.html) |
| [Thinking with Type (3rd edition)](https://papress.com/products/thinking-with-type-3-edition) | Ellen Lupton's primer on letter, text and grid, revised with material on non-Latin writing systems and typeface design | Read the Grid chapter before any layout-heavy graphic | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Better Web Type](https://betterwebtype.com) | Web typography course and articles for developers | Take the free course in order (rhythm, scale, line length, pairing), then keep the articles for reference | A | course | static | freemium · slow |  |
| [Pimp my Type](https://pimpmytype.com) | Font reviews, pairing and UI-typography advice | Look up font-of-the-week reviews for well-judged open fonts | A | article | static | free |  |
| [web.dev: font best practices](https://web.dev/articles/font-best-practices) | Font loading, preloading, subsetting and font-display strategy | Follow its checklist when adding any web font: self-host or preconnect, preload only the critical file, choose font-display deliberately, subset | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Google Fonts Knowledge](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge) | Structured lessons on choosing, pairing and using type, including variable fonts | Look up a topic (pairing, legibility, OpenType features) | A | guideline | js | free |  |
| [Web Design is 95% Typography](https://ia.net/topics/the-web-is-all-about-typography-period) | The classic argument that treating text as UI is most of web design | Read once to recalibrate: treat text as the interface and judge a layout by its reading experience | B | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [The Elements of Typographic Style Applied to the Web](https://webtypography.net) | Bringhurst's principles translated into CSS | Look up a Bringhurst principle (rhythm, measure, proportion) and its web translation; take the principle, not the dated CSS | B | guideline | blocked | free · archived |  |

## CJK type and typesetting (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) · 中日韩字体与排版

Open-licence Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts, licence directories, web-font slicing, and the typesetting rules for punctuation, line breaking and mixed scripts. Commercial CJK font licensing is actively enforced.
